rows.text:
The latest entry in Astropolis's most adorable superhero series!
Defeated once by Holy Wubbaboo, the Thick-Armed Wolf
leads every evil Wubbaboo from across the parallel universes for its resurgence!
When the lone traveler is battered and broken, betrayed by his own brothers,
when a once-celebrated hero comes crashing down in a storm of criticism,
can the Holy Wubbaboo stay true to itself
and triumph over tens of millions of evil versions of itself?

"Think, Holy Wubbaboo, think!"
